fog.label: infinitely many undrawn primes
fog.scope: input value; no lens computation at undrawn places

notes: Low digit at the root; certificates may be deeper than the requested drawing.
Seed not given means the polynomial solver printed no branch identifier.
Depth handles select stored results. The viewer performs no arithmetic on values.

derived.rule: D-UX5 as amended 2026-10-16: these numbers are computed in scene.py by a finite computation from a printed driver line, and each names that line by its index in provenance.records
derived.digits: trees[].depths[].paths[]: digits, digit_string, nodes and end_exponent are the base-p digits (digit_path) of centre, printed in provenance.records[source_record].output
derived.node_balls: trees[].depths[].node_balls: the drawn sibling balls, from the digits of the paths of the same depth; source provenance.records[paths[].source_record]
derived.counts: trees[].depths[]: branch_count and lit_path_count count the balls of provenance.records[record].output and their distinct digit paths
derived.fog: fog: the primes below 1000 dividing the modulus printed in provenance.records[fog.source_record].output, and their count
derived.modular_digits: modular_solutions[].digits: the first digits of the components printed in provenance.records[records[3]].output
